resources.string:
Self Watch keeps your health data on this phone. It has no account, no cloud and no analytics.

What it writes to Health Connect: weight, body fat, food (nutrition), water, steps, distance, active calories, workouts, sleep, heart rate, heart rate variability, blood oxygen and breathing rate, from your watch and your own entries.

What it reads from Health Connect: weight, body fat, food, steps, workouts and sleep from other apps, so your Self Watch diary and charts are complete.

Why: so the apps you choose can share the same data, and you can see everything in one place.

Data from Health Connect stays on this phone. Self Watch never sends it anywhere. It reads the last 30 days unless you ask it to import older data, and reads in the background only if you turn on automatic sync.

You can change or remove these permissions at any time in Health Connect settings. Data Self Watch read can be removed again from the import history in Self Watch.
